author: The Hacker News
content: CISA adds two actively exploited Cisco and GitLab flaws to its KEV catalog. GitLab: CVSS 10.0 RCE flaw targeted in an attempted attack on Alpine Linux. Cisco: Firewall flaw can trigger device reloads and DoS. Federal agencies must patch by November 1.

author: Threat Intelligence
content: New Lindnor Backdoor and Glut of Security Killers Used in Ransomware Attack on U.S. Org. Attackers using the Anubis ransomware deployed a new custom backdoor and numerous BYOVD tools.
